moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ambient-hold, written here): Hold demo (4000 ms loop): the title stays readable but breathes, scale 1 ± 1.5 % on a 2 s sine, while 18 faint dots drift upward at 11–22 px/s (wrapping). Recipe: enter 0–600 ms, hold 600–3400 ms with the background on a 4 s sine, exit 3400–4000 ms; no fully static frame, rest 40–60 % of the film. Params: breathe (±1.5 %, 2 s) · drift (11–22 px/s) · hold (2.8 s). Rule: no fully still frame; holds take 40–60 % of the film.
